title: Graph Engineering integrated barrier policy
description: Direct config of a Graph IR node whose kind is 'barrier'. There is no config.policy wrapper and no inference from edges or metadata. apiVersion is the ownership discriminator: a barrier config is a claimed policy only if it carries that exact value, so pre-contract configs without it are not interpreted as policies at all. onUnsatisfied and lateArrival are required for every kind and have no default, because a silently defaulted unsatisfied barrier is the implicit pass this contract exists to forbid. Each kind declares exactly its own threshold member; unevaluatedProperties therefore rejects a threshold that belongs to a different kind.

apiVersion.description: Ownership discriminator. A barrier config is a claimed policy if and only if it carries this exact value. A barrier config without it is not interpreted by the barrier compiler pass at all, which is what keeps pre-contract configs such as {"condition": "all"} compiling. Ownership is a versioned claim the author states, never a shape the compiler guesses.

onUnsatisfied.description: Resolution applied when the policy is not satisfied. None of the three members is a pass.

lateArrival.description: Behavior when an upstream settles after the decision is committed.

deadline.description: Optional for every kind. Evaluated only against the injected monotonic clock at scheduler quiescence points; no wall clock and no timer participates.

countAbstainAsParticipant.description: When false, abstentions are removed from the participant denominator. An unknown vote always remains a participant and never becomes an accept.
